flags.title: HRV below normal range
flags.detail: 7-day HRV average 42 ms is under your normal range (49–65 ms). Typical causes: accumulated training stress, illness, alcohol, poor sleep.

guidance.headline: Keep it moderate
guidance.detail: Aerobic work is fine; hold the intervals and heavy lifts for a fresher day.

profile._max_hr_note: null = estimate 208 - 0.7 x age (Tanaka). Your measured max from Garmin is better.

nutrition._day_type_note: Calories and carbs flex by day type; protein stays fixed. With several types in one day the largest adjustment applies.

training._duration_load_note: Load per minute when heart rate can't score a session (swims, lifts, no HR). ~1.5/min is a moderate effort on the TRIMP scale.

swim._note: Swims count total session time (rests and drills included) and are scored from Garmin's Aerobic Training Effect, since wrist HR is unreliable in water. Load per minute = base + per_te x (TE - 1).
